items.title: A disclosure review binds the recipient and exact grant, not only content
items.observation: An otherwise reviewed projection can be misdirected or silently revived if recipient, object and immutable client-grant digest are not checked with the exact content digest; replacing a revoked grant must not repair the old review.
items.product_implication: 8BALL disclosure review must preserve exact recipient/grant/content scope separately from evidence state and action authority; keep revoked and withdrawn records terminal and auditable.

history.reason: Existing-task B03-03 safety refinement demonstrated with controlled SQLite tests; no global acceptance or new required scope.

items.title: A safe source preview is not the final disclosure commit gate
items.origin: Collaboration/vault same-transaction seam discussion and implementation
items.observation: Standalone safe metadata or source handles cannot authorize a projection mutation: source access, release state, revision, integrity and retention may change between preview and commit. The source gate and mutation/audit must share the same active write transaction.
items.product_implication: Keep a fail-closed transaction-local vault gate in 8BALL integration; opaque handles are references, never bearer capabilities. Missing or different-database adapters deny rather than granting local bearer access.

history.reason: Existing-task refinement with explicitly confirmed vault contract and controlled wrapper tests; actual shared identity/vault/case combination remains an integration gate.

items.title: Client source readiness checks must not create internal source read access
items.observation: Reusing a vault current-READ source gate under the client identity could require a broad internal grant merely to read curated projection content. Checking source lifecycle under the still-current independent reviewer, while separately checking the exact client projection grant, keeps those authorities distinct.
items.product_implication: Allow clients only the separately reviewed content allowlist; deny after reviewer or source access revocation without exposing source handles, metadata or internal objects. Host role/route mappings still require negative integration tests.

history.reason: Existing-task B03-03 distinction; controlled test denies client source authority while allowing only reviewed projection, not proof of production policy correctness.

items.title: Measure exact disclosure review and refresh recovery burden
items.origin: Collaboration isolated UI and failure-recovery build review
items.observation: Exact recipient IDs, digests, separate review and explicit refresh after uncertain writes may prevent misdirected disclosure but also impose substantial manual review and recovery work; screen and passing-test counts do not show net operator benefit.
items.product_implication: Evaluate fictional-user disclosure tasks with wrong-recipient prevention, correction rate, review time and stale-refresh recovery measures before expanding the interface or claiming customer value.

history.reason: Retain for owner/usability review; no participant study, native new-flow review or new mandatory roadmap task is authorized or claimed.

items.title: Checkout tests alone do not prove installed-kernel test portability
items.origin: Collaboration isolated ENDSTATE wheel regression failure and repair
items.observation: 1393 checkout tests passed while two collaboration tests could not collect under the installed-kernel runner's isolated importlib mode because sibling fixture imports were unqualified. Package-qualified test imports then passed 37 focused tests in both modes and 1393 installed-wheel regressions.
items.product_implication: Preserve installed-package verification alongside checkout tests for 8BALL/ENDSTATE work; distinguish a test portability repair from a kernel defect or broad acceptance. Keep the failed source-bound receipt rather than replacing it with later totals.

history.reason: Existing-task verification refinement, corrected within owned tests and proven by final offline wheel/native runner; no new required scope, production/platform portability or B03 acceptance claim.
